parole.significato: Any of a race of giant heroes in the folklore of the peoples of the North Caucasus (notably the Circassians, Ossetians,…
parole.testo: From a North Caucasian source (see West Circassian нарт (nart) and Ossetian нарт (nart)), ultimately from Proto-Indo-European *h₂nḗr ("man, hero").
